( temporary article)


After the foundation by [[Vurahin]] according to a legend, [[Vurahi]] was ruled for a period of 350 years by a monarchical system, initially with sovereigns of Arten later by Mepqo Kings. The tradition handed down seven kings: [[Vurahin]], [[Numa]], [[Tullarzian]], [[Ancuzelam]], [[Tarquinius]], [[KIng Vera|Vera]] and [[Mepqovian The last]].
